run_long_form_transcription_eval: run the script to evaluate a Whisper model on long-form transcription datasets using JAX and Flax
convert_dataset_str_to_list: convert a plus-separated dataset name string into a list of dataset configuration dictionaries
compute_wer_metrics: compute WER, IER, SER, DER, and repeated n-gram metrics for speech recognition evaluation
log_predictions_to_wandb: log ground truth and predicted transcriptions as a table to Weights & Biases with optional audio samples
run_flax_whisper_pipeline: run the FlaxWhisperPipeline to transcribe audio files with configurable chunking, beam search, and sampling
